name: fresca-bike-rentals
description: fRESCA Bike Rentals - motorcycle rentals in Kadapa and Proddatur.

scripts.dev: node scripts/require-prisma-schema.mjs && prisma generate && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: node scripts/require-prisma-schema.mjs && prisma generate && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/require-prisma-schema.mjs && prisma generate && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: node scripts/require-prisma-schema.mjs && prisma generate && npm run test -w backend
